target.statement: Construct endogenous recursive formation under the original smooth two-sector KL/Fisher dynamics, for general probability laws and distinct children, with exact parent dynamics, boundary responses, and collective geometry, without a prescribed hierarchy or an erasure gate.
target.quantifiers: There exist a finite population of at least four agents, admissible normalized constitutive data, and a nonempty declared class of initially unpartitioned preparations, such that the same autonomous fine dynamics selects a persistent first parent organization and then a parent containing at least two first-stage parents. State the timing and persistence precisely. Prove exact inheritance for every preparation and every admitted response/control history in that class. Any finite-time, asymptotic, stratum-specific, or infinite-population conclusion retains that restriction and cannot establish an unrestricted alternative.
domains: General normalized probability laws on declared standard Borel represented-content spaces; bounded positive density charts or explicitly justified regular statistical families when differentiating.
Complete law configurations including both q and s sectors and their original source rows, with no probability distribution over configurations unless separately declared.
Smooth contextual sections and their collective Fisher geometry on a regular stratum; the context base is distinct from represented sample coordinates.
codomains: Parent law/configuration spaces with normalized evaluators, declared response kernels, exact inherited flow, and explicit joining maps.
State- or accessible-history-selected membership structures, rather than a supplied binary tree.
Coarse regular statistical bundles with the inherited collective minimizing connection class and the corresponding contextual residual tensor, with every loss or defect identified.
target.regularity: The fine evolution is the original smooth unit-mobility Fisher gradient of the current manuscript potential, either with dynamic source rows or its explicitly identified Gibbs-reduced version. State local/global existence, regularity, domination, and differentiation assumptions for each result. Analytic specializations do not replace the full smooth target.
measures: Proper reference joint laws R_i=r_i G_i; all interaction and response kernels normalized.
Finite relative entropies and justified integrals on each declared regular domain; non-Gaussian laws permitted and no Gaussian closure assumed.
boundary_conditions: Remain on the declared regular positive domain for every finite-time statement; boundary, singular, infinite-time, and infinite-population limits require separate proofs.
Response/control classes are declared before their preservation is tested. Restricting them changes the scope and may not be introduced solely to conceal a failed response.
symmetries: Passive gauge covariance under the manuscript convention D^A p=dp+J_p A and A'=Ad_g A-(dg)g^{-1}.
Relabeling naturality for identical constitutive data; asymmetric initial configurations may break permutation symmetry.
Any active sample symmetry is distinguished from passive frame changes.
target.equivalence: Parents must forget actual fine configuration information beyond merely renaming agents or storing the full child tuple. Distinct children remain distinct during the claimed formation interval. Dynamics uses the original time unless an explicit time-change qualification is retained. Full joint admitted response histories, not just isolated marginals, must agree. Collective connection classes are compared modulo the stated stabilizers, with actual nontrivial geometry distinguished from a zero-tensor example.
premises: Use the original smooth KL potential, including all receiver, sender, and state-dependent-channel derivatives and original positive source-row temperatures.
No imposed child synchronization, added fusion penalty, prescribed hierarchy, manufactured erasure gate, or new attraction inserted at a parent level.
Initial laws and constitutive channels must be specified; a tree-shaped invariant preparation is a conditional prior construction, not a solution to endogenous hierarchy selection.
The manuscript's existing conditional inheritance theorems and obstructions are prior work whose hypotheses must be retained.
permitted_theorems: Elementary measure disintegration and conditional-expectation identities with hypotheses checked.
Local ODE uniqueness, inverse/constant rank theorems, and analytic continuation on a declared analytic specialization.
Exact lumpability, score projection, and collective-connection inheritance results only after matching every hypothesis.
target.falsification_criterion: A complete negative answer must exclude every admissible construction in the stated existential class. A failed route, finite example, analytic specialization, or observation obstruction alone leaves the target unresolved.
target.literature_policy: Consult the live manuscript, wiki, and linked prior investigations first. External theoretical claims require inspected primary sources, with exact hypotheses mapped. Use a bounded search of journal, arXiv, and author-hosted papers; make no novelty or exhaustive-literature claim. At most three substantive constructive rounds; stop earlier after two rounds without a new checkable result.
